title: History-informed original loop against the native smolagents agent: step 1 baseline study (creates history), step 2 v3-history Learn campaign
declared_by: Claude (Opus 5.5) as PM, delegated by the project owner
source_commit: b85715c (backup/part2-2026-09-22), runtime 08e4c20d, discovery v3 available: True

step1.what: product baseline study on planned native campaign campaign-aaceaf2fa0554540adb1008d286e2f7d (all 6 public development cases x 3 x 2 arms; dev-1 in the plan is nominal; no hand-picked cases)
step1.max_calls: 144 reserved + up to 144 charged transport retries = 288
step1.stop_rules: stop at once on any LAB_ERROR/INTERRUPTED (after the single allowed retry), any B1 control deviation, INCOMPLETE, > 288 calls, 45 minutes

step2.what: one Learn campaign with discovery protocol faultlab-discovery/v3-history in the SAME store, planned only after step 1 ends; the history summary is frozen into the plan at creation (hash + record cutoff recorded in DECLARATION-step2.json before Start). The Explorer chooses freely; a re-pick of a development-case recipe surfaced by the history is allowed and will be reported as such.
step2.stop_rules: Product ends itself on NO_CHANGE/COMPLETED/ERROR/STOPPED. Watcher v2 stops on: more than 8 discovery selections; before any counterexample, used_calls > 144 or charged > 3.47 dollars (step-2 campaign's own budget); disk < 2 GiB; 6 hours. Operator stops on world-integrity failure, two consecutive LAB_ERROR, auth/config/frozen-model failure, source drift. Never restart, replace or reroll; if a source appears the loop continues within the ledger ceiling.
step2.meanings: ACCEPTED would be the project's first generated-policy acceptance and is conditional on post-run integrity checks; it would not show transfer, held-out safety or generality, and the source may be a re-pick of a public development recipe surfaced by history. NO_CHANGE/REJECTED are honest outcomes.
